reasons: Adds no value over existing pages: Every dated fact checks out against primary or near-primary sources, but the body is a stats and timeline list with a citation tag on nearly every sentence, and the sentence rhythm is formulaic. The injury and World Cup sections add context only. Nothing here goes beyond the top search results (no correction, no primary source the others missed, no clearer timeline). The contract is press-only and undated in the body, and the FAQ and metaDescription state it without a hedge.

Reviewer recommends rejection: Facts check out against the opened sources (birth date, birthplace, caps, loan, permanent move, debut, injury, World Cup omission). Reject on style and value grounds, and because the unhedged press-only contract claim appears in the FAQ and metaDescription. Fixes: (1) hedge the contract as reported in the FAQ answer and metaDescription, and state it as undated, matching the body; (2) rewrite the prose so it reads as a person wrote it, with fewer per-sentence citation tags; (3) add something the top results lack (a clearer timeline, a primary-source detail, or a correction) or do not publish.
